title: [model-routing S3] Backfill model tiers with a reversible audited manifest
body:
**Blocked by:** #1152, #1153
**Model tier:** high

## Context
Model tier rationale: This change establishes a cross-process routing and execution contract with failure and concurrency paths.
The user approved the complete model-tier routing plan and authorized implementation, deployment and a bounded live pilot. Work item S3.

## Task
Reassess every current open issue plus linked source issues for open PRs against its complete Task/AC and code. Produce a dry-run before/after manifest with hashes, rationale, conflicts and exclusions. Apply only metadata/Context rationale with fresh pre-write hash comparison, post-write verification and resumable ledger; rollback only unchanged applied bodies. Preserve labels, blockers, Tasks, follow-up markers and native epic links. Keep proposed issues proposed. Stage a low/medium/high pilot, monitor complete processing and fix routing/review/runtime failures until the declared behavior is proven.

## Touches

- `.github/scripts/model-tier-assessment.json` — dated English rationale and source hash for every assessed open issue.
- `docs/operations/relay-model-tiers.md` — migration and pilot operations.
- .github/scripts/
- thread-storage reports/relay-model-routing/

## Scope
### In scope
The mechanism above, its failure-path tests and necessary documentation.
### Out of scope
Per-step model selection, automatic cross-tier fallback, new budget infrastructure and unrelated cleanup.

## Acceptance criteria
- Every dispatchable issue has valid metadata. Conflicts are reported without overwriting concurrent edits. Excluded epics/manual checkpoints remain non-dispatchable. Pilot proves actual selected model, snapshot stability, review and successful end-to-end processing.
- Relevant local verification and CI pass before deployment.
